title: kate-ui: load the project of the open file
summary: kate-ui gains the kate-session dependency. When a document with a path opens, the window looks for its .kateproject with find_project_file, loads it, and keeps the Project and its file list on the window. A document outside a project clears them. The panes and quick open read that list.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// The project of `path` and its relative file list, or None when no .kateproject is above it or it does not load.
fn project_for(path: &std::path::Path) -> Option<(kate_session::Project, Vec<std::path::PathBuf>)>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add kate-session to the kate-ui dependencies with the justification comment and run cargo update -p kate-ui so Cargo.lock gains the edge only. Store project: Option<(Project, Vec<PathBuf>)> on WindowRoot. After open_document and after each OpenPath request with a path, set it from project_for; a load or files error shows one notice sentence and leaves None. The test project_for_finds_the_tree_above_a_file builds a tempdir with .kateproject {"name": "T", "files": [{"directory": "."}]} and src/a.rs, and asserts project_for(src/a.rs) is Some with name T and a file list that holds src/a.rs. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::project_for_finds_the_tree_above_a_file
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because project_for does not exist. After the change a file under a project directory loads the project and its file list.
